d: With three grown daughters who are happy living at home, Simone and Madan ran out of room long ago, and their crowded house is seriously cramping their style.

Nurse Jenna and firefighter Neil are ready to settle down in a home of their own, but first they have to flip his frat house. It’s a fixer upper that never happened, and now Jonathan’s stepping in to transform it
A blended family struggles to find a new home that suits all their needs.
With a big dog, a rambunctious toddler, and a baby who literally sleeps in the closet, stay-at-home dad Chip and working-mom Danielle juggle their busy schedule in a home they’ve long since outgrown.
Francis and Juanita moved from India to Canada five years ago and bought the first house they could afford.
Abby, David, and their son are feeling the squeeze in their tiny home, with another baby on the way.
With three growing kids, Missy and Jay are looking for a sprawling forever home. But before they go anywhere, they’ve got to transform their current home into a showpiece.

Soon-to-be-empty-nesters Novella and Terry are downsizing from a sprawling five-bedroom home to a single-story property. But first, their current home is bland and sparse and in desperate need of an overhaul.
With a second child on the way, this young couple is desperate for a larger space.

Sunita and David are desperate for more space, but their current home’s overcrowded interiors are holding them back. With two kids and no storage space, the house is overrun with toys and David’s hobbies.
Tired of squeezing into his bachelor pad condo and ready to move to the suburbs, Erin and Adam are searching for the perfect family-friendly home.

Stuck in the suburbs, living with their parents, lovebirds Tim and Michelle are itching to move to the city and buy their own pad. The Property Brothers come to the rescue and help the couple find a budget-friendly home.

Having lived in 4 houses in 4 years and now crammed into a tiny apartment, Marianne and Steve crave a high-end house to call home. The Property Brothers come to the rescue and help the couple find a budget-friendly home.

Minneapolis natives Mark and Dave have relocated to Vegas—along with Mark’s glamourous alter ego, Margo. And now they’re itching to get out of their rental and into a mid-century modern gem of their own.

Cramped in a tiny condo with newborn twins and a two-year-old daughter, Luke and Courtney are desperate to buy a new house. The Property Brothers come to the rescue and help them find a budget-friendly dream home.
After years of being on the road, Sonja has finally landed a job closer to family in Nashville.

Busy parents Dorothy and John have been crashing in his parents’ basement, and with baby number two on the way they’re desperate to find a home of their own. It’s a race against time, and the Property Brothers step in.

With a baby on the way, Christine and Thomas are ready to settle down. Thomas has promised to find Christine her downtown dream home before their baby arrives. But until he does, they’re crashing at a friend’s place.

Busy professionals Samira and Shawn are living out of a suitcase as they hunt for the perfect house-ideally a luxury pad close to Shawn's office. The Property Brothers help them find a budget-friendly dream home.
Newlyweds, busy professionals, and animal lovers, Sophie, Tim, and their two dogs are determined to get out of his cramped condo.
